name: Sound-choice modal: running dribble lines up with the court floor
description: The FTUE SOUND CHECK sprite runs ~3s of the court running-with-ball animation then the spin move. Guards three regressions. (1) BALL/PLAYER RATIO: the court draws <Player scale=1.5> but <Ball scale=1>, so the court ratio is ball 7 units : player 21 = 0.333. This modal originally drew BOTH at scale 1 (ratio 0.500), rendering the ball exactly 1.5x too big. Asserted via the rendered rect widths - player pixels must be 1.5 units, ball pixels 1. (2) WRONG SPRITE: it once rendered the standing dribble pose (SPRITE_PIXELS) instead of RUN_BALL_FRAMES. (3) FLOOR ALIGNMENT: BALL_FRAMES ink does not fill its 7x7 box (all phases bottom out at local row 5, not 6) and Ball.jsx centres on the BOX, so the ball used to hang clear of the ground. Floor is the bottom EDGE of the feet ink row: 38*1.5+1.5 = 58.5. Also guards the sprite/ball phase lock - both must derive their frame from ABSOLUTE time like Player.jsx. METHOD: rAF is paused while the runner evaluates, so sampling over time inside one eval returns frozen values. Every assertion is instantaneous instead, repeated across the cycle so it lands in both phases.

steps._comment: bob is the FTUE user (gamesPlayed 0), so the SOUND CHECK modal renders. carol has played and never sees it.
switchUser may restart the dev server
Force a real reload - HMR has served stale client bundles in this repo before.
The run-with-ball sprite must exist at all - this is the swap away from the standing dribble pose.

steps.expression: (() => { const sv = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-sprite]'); if (!sv) throw new Error('sound-choice sprite missing'); const ph = sv.getAttribute('data-phase'); const ty = (el) => { const m = (el.getAttribute('transform')||'').match(/translate\(\s*(-?[\d.]+)[ ,]+(-?[\d.]+)/); return m ? parseFloat(m[2]) : 0; }; const inkBottom = (g) => { let m = -Infinity; g.querySelectorAll('rect').forEach(r => { const b = parseFloat(r.getAttribute('y')) + parseFloat(r.getAttribute('height')); if (b > m) m = b; }); return m; }; const rectW = (g) => parseFloat(g.querySelector('rect').getAttribute('width')); const PS = 1.5, FLOOR = 58.5; if (ph === 'spin') { const sg = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-spin]'); if (!sg) throw new Error('spin phase but no spin group'); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-ball]')) throw new Error('REGRESSION: a separate <Ball> is mounted during the spin. SPIN_MOVE_FRAMES already contains the ball, so this double-draws it.'); if (document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-run]')) throw new Error('run sprite still mounted during spin phase'); const sw = rectW(sg); if (sw !== PS) throw new Error('SCALE: spin sprite pixels are ' + sw + ' units, expected ' + PS + '. The court draws <Player scale=1.5>.'); const sb = inkBottom(sg); if (sb !== FLOOR) throw new Error('spin sprite floor edge ' + sb + ', expected ' + FLOOR); return 'spin ok rects=' + sg.querySelectorAll('rect').length + ' px=' + sw + ' floor=' + sb; } if (ph !== 'dribble') throw new Error('unexpected phase: ' + ph); const rg = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-run]'); if (!rg) throw new Error('dribble phase but no run-with-ball sprite'); const bw = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-choice-ball]'); if (!bw) throw new Error('dribble phase but no ball'); const bg = bw.querySelector('g'); if (!bg) throw new Error('ball wrapper has no inner group'); const rf = parseInt(sv.getAttribute('data-run-frame'), 10); if (!(rf >= 0 && rf <= 5)) throw new Error('run frame out of RUN_BALL_FRAMES range: ' + rf); const rn = rg.querySelectorAll('rect').length; if (rn < 45 || rn > 65) throw new Error('run sprite has ' + rn + ' rects, outside RUN_BALL_FRAMES (51-59). Wrong sprite - the standing dribble pose is ~40.'); const pw = rectW(rg), bp = rectW(bg); if (pw !== PS) throw new Error('SCALE: run sprite pixels are ' + pw + ' units, expected ' + PS + '. The court draws <Player scale=1.5>.'); if (bp !== 1) throw new Error('SCALE: ball pixels are ' + bp + ' units, expected 1. The court draws <Ball scale=1> even while the player is at 1.5 - that asymmetry is deliberate.'); const ratio = (7 * bp) / (14 * pw); if (Math.abs(ratio - 1/3) > 0.001) throw new Error('BALL/PLAYER RATIO is ' + ratio.toFixed(3) + ', but the court is 0.333 (ball 7 units : player 14*1.5=21). A ratio of 0.500 means both were drawn at the same scale, which renders the ball exactly 1.5x too big.'); const feet = ty(rg) + inkBottom(rg); if (feet !== FLOOR) throw new Error('feet bottom edge ' + feet + ', expected the floor line ' + FLOOR); const ly = inkBottom(bg); if (ly !== 6) throw new Error('ball ink local bottom ' + ly + ', expected 6. BALL_FRAMES ink stops at row 5 inside its 7x7 box.'); const TBL = [10, 4, -2, -3, -2, 4]; const base = ty(bg) - TBL[rf]; const deepest = base + 10 + ly; if (deepest !== feet) throw new Error('BALL FLOOR/PHASE: at the deepest point of the stride the ball underside computes to ' + deepest + ' but the feet are at ' + feet + ' (off by ' + (feet - deepest) + '). Measured ty=' + ty(bg) + ' rf=' + rf + ' implied base=' + base + ' (expected 42.5 = BALL_CY 46 - 3.5). Causes: BALL_CY drift, or a sprite/ball phase desync from not deriving both frames off absolute time.'); return 'dribble ok rf=' + rf + ' px=' + pw + ' ballpx=' + bp + ' ratio=' + ratio.toFixed(3) + ' ballBottom=' + (ty(bg) + ly) + ' feet=' + feet; })()
